title: Owner Approvals — Central Nostalgic Camera
governing_principle: You (Owner) → ShriYantra (authority and control) → Vyomaraj/Bharath (central intelligence) + Jarvis/Laxman (coordination and content movement) → agents and sub-agents → content creation and verification → THIS QUEUE → approved publishing → social platforms → analytics and monetization → learning and improvement. Hermes guards integrity and recovery across the entire process. Arena executes approved tasks; it is not the owner or the authority root.

camera.style: Wooden old-style shutter camera — nostalgic look
camera.interaction: Published candidates arrive in a queue shown as a dropdown. When the owner picks one, the wooden shutter opens, the item's video and sound play for review, and the owner takes the appropriate action.
camera.playback: Local review payload only: video and sound play as described metadata in this prototype. No media is hosted, uploaded or streamed.
camera.shutter: opens on pick, closes on decision

buddies.rule: Vyomaraj and Jarvis always notify the owner for every decision point, every morning briefing and every escalation.

decision_meanings.approve: Owner approves the item for the publishing gate (still recorded, never auto-published).
decision_meanings.reject: Owner rejects the item; the reason is kept and the creating agents are notified.
decision_meanings.rework: Owner requests changes; the item returns to the creating agents and comes back through the same approval cycle.
decision_meanings.submit: Owner submits additional instructions with the item and it stays in the cycle until explicitly approved or rejected.

voice_instructions.loop: Owner speaks an instruction with the decision → the instruction is attached to the decision record → agents rework accordingly → the item resubmits → the same camera approval cycle repeats.

notifications.policy: Vyomaraj and Jarvis always notify the owner

publishing.rule: Nothing is published by this prototype. Approval records are planning metadata only.

queue.title: Chitra Katha — The Monsoon Post (issue plan)
queue.version_line: past v1/v2 preserved · future v3/v4 plannable

review_payload.sound_note: Original dialogue samples in Marathi, Hindi and English.

review_payload.video_note: Timed editorial rundown with source credits; no playback attached.
review_payload.sound_note: Presenter commentary plan; no licensed recording attached.
review_payload.description: Editorial slot budgets, not measured track lengths.

escalation.finance_and_audit: Jarvis and Vyomaraj always follow up with the Finance and auditing agents; payment follow-up and morning briefings live in /finance/.
escalation.change_management: Post-deployment changes follow /upgrades/: owner instruction → ShriYantra alignment → agent coordination → version-controlled change → separate testing → permission → upgrade, with backup plan and rollback on failure.
